name: provenote
description: A C2PA honesty test: drop an image, see its full provenance chain in plain language, then the Gallery of Limits — three adversarially-built demonstrations of what a valid chain does not and cannot prove. Nothing uploads.

scripts.build: pnpm run brand && pnpm run copy-wasm && pnpm run copy-fixtures && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run zero-functions
scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run unit && pnpm run fixtures:verify && pnpm run build && pnpm run e2e:full
